industrial_blockchain_traceability.evidence: Operational Crystalchain private Ethereum/PoA traceability at Chargeurs Luxury Materials wool combing factory in China.

batch_lca.evidence: Static OpenLCA comparison of generic and more specific inventories; FU1kg combed wool top lot at factory gate; ecoinventv3 and ReCiPe2016.

method_disclosure.evidence: FU, cradle-to-gate boundary, source table and generic/specific-data methodology explicitly documented offchain.

fully_primary_upstream_inventory.evidence: §3.1 explicitly reports unavailable specific supplier-farm inventories; literature farm archetypes used.

all_lca_inputs_on_blockchain.evidence: §3.2 explicitly reports emailed client data; energy and chemicals not available on the platform.

contract_enforced_factor_version_and_cer.evidence: No corresponding contract implementation or revision-lifecycle test located.

common_assumptions: Same units, sources, factor manifests and calculation engine
Same offchain evidence and retention policy
Same adversary powers; explicit key compromise and operator collusion assumptions
signed_central_counterfactual.central_log: Single ordering/administration authority; signatures and hash chaining detect content alteration when verifiers retain authentic receipts/checkpoints. Independently witnessed checkpoints can reveal equivocation; they do not prevent withholding or replicate state-machine governance.
signed_central_counterfactual.permissioned_ledger: Potential shared ordering and execution with independently operated validators and a stated consensus fault threshold. Admission, key management, storage and source-data correctness still need governance.
signed_central_counterfactual.single_governor: A single controller of all validators, administrative keys and storage reintroduces central trust. Neither design verifies physical inputs or the adequacy of emission factors.
signed_central_counterfactual.evidence_class: Analytical threat-model comparison based on NISTIR 8202, sections 3.5 and 7.1–7.8 (Table 9 of the article).
